facts.fact: Gabon Media Time reports that the law ratifying the social-network ordinance, promulgated by decree 0436/PR of 5 October 2026, bans deepfakes of public or private persons (art. 32) and requires editors within 12 months to deploy AI-content detection and a visible, permanent label on AI-generated content (art. 53).
facts.system: Law ratifying the ordinance on social-network regulation

GAB.note: No body with a mandate over AI harms is named (only a judge in summary proceedings), and no enforcement is stated.
The document states no government use of AI.
The document states no AI in a public sector system.
The document states no AI model, dataset or computing built in the country.

facts.fact: Gabon Media Time reports that the law ratifying the social-network ordinance, promulgated by decree 0436/PR of 5 October 2026, punishes use of a third party's identifying elements to deceive users and take their confidential data with five years' imprisonment and a fine of FCFA 5-20 million (art. 51).
facts.system: Law ratifying the ordinance on social-network regulation

GAB.note: The document states no data protection law or authority; it covers social-network rules only.
